note: Attacker-controlled projection parameter is read into north_square from the input definition string.
The code validates north_square and should reject out-of-range values before use; this is the critical decision point for the index.
The square value is later used as a rotation selector for polar-cap rearrangement.
The selector is converted to an array index and used to fetch a matrix from the rot table.
This fixed-size lookup table is the sink: an invalid selector can lead to out-of-bounds array access during rotation lookup.
